item.title: Apple Reports Record Q4 Earnings, $AAPL Surges 5%
item.description: Apple Inc. reported record fourth quarter earnings Thursday, with revenue of $125 billion beating Wall Street expectations. The strong results were driven by iPhone sales and services growth.
item.author: Yahoo Finance Staff

item.title: Microsoft Azure Growth Accelerates, MSFT Shares Rise
item.description: Microsoft Corporation reported that Azure cloud revenue grew 33% year-over-year, exceeding analyst estimates. The company also raised its quarterly dividend.

item.title: Tesla Deliveries Miss Estimates Amid EV Competition
item.description: Tesla Inc. reported quarterly deliveries of 484,000 vehicles, falling short of the 510,000 analyst consensus estimate. Competition from Chinese EV makers weighed on results.
